priorStatuses.title: Parse the cached payload instead of the wrapper

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body: When two tenants use the same document ID, `db.find({ documentId })` can return another tenant’s document. Any tenant-scoped request through `getDocument` can therefore expose or operate on cross-tenant state because `ctx.tenantId` is no longer included in the query.
